note: The light of the open world as it is drawn (ui/play/ground_art.gd makes the shadow tiles, ui/play/world_look.gd draws the rest, ui/play/tile_view.gd and ui/play/sandbox_screen.gd use them, tools/check_data.gd checks it). The sun is in the north-west (docs/ART_STYLE.md), so shadows fall to the south-east. `shadow`: a soft ellipse of `color` on the ground under what stands on it; `shapes` are drawn in a tile of 16 pixels (centre cx, cy and radii rx, ry in pixels, `alpha` at the core), `kinds` says which standing thing (a node or decor glyph) throws which shape, and `building` is the offset (in tiles) and fade of a town building's shadow, drawn as `layers` soft boxes. `grade`: the colour of the light laid over the map: the tint of GameDay.look at up to `night_alpha` as the light fails, and the warm sun on the day (`sun_color` at `sun_alpha` of full sun). `glow`: at night (the sun's light under `from_sun`) a soft additive halo of `radius` tiles round hearths, anvils, forges, camp fires and lit windows; `flicker` is how far its strength wanders (still with reduced motion). `weather`: rain streaks and snow flakes drawn over the map from GameDay.look's `precip` (`count` for a 1280 by 720 view, scaled by `intensity` of the weather; `fall` is screen heights a second), off with reduced motion; `fog_alpha` is how much a fog greys the view. `vignette`: the soft dark at the edge of the map, darker by `night_boost` at night.
